raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "be damaged by"
      role subject ?b
      role object "the flood"
      role time "May"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "repair"
      role subject ?c
      role object ?b
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "win"
      role subject ?c
      role object "the tender"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
